data.name: Little Rock Central High School National Historic Site Visitor Center
data.description: The Visitor Center parking lot has 32 vehicle spaces, 5 RV/Bus parking spaces and 2 accessible spaces; parking is for visitors to the National Historic Site only. No overnight parking is allowed; all violators may be towed at their own expense. Bus/RV parking spaces are approximately 14 feet wide x 40 feet long.
